item.title: Does dark matter actually exist? New theory says it could be gravity behaving strangely
item.description: "It highlights gravity's possible hidden complexity and invites a reevaluation of where dark matter effects originate."

item.title: SpaceX Dragon arrives for Crew-12 launch | Space photo of the day for Feb. 6, 2026
item.description: Crew-12's timeline has been unusually dynamic.

item.title: Nearby star's massive eruption could help astronomers unlock secret of superflares
item.description: Astronomers witnessed a star emitting as much energy in mere moments as our sun puts out in a few months. The dramatic observation gives a direct look into the brutal physics of these stellar events.

item.title: When will SpaceX's Falcon 9 rocket return to flight after 4 upper-stage issues in 19 months?
item.description: For the fourth time in the last 19 months, the upper stage of SpaceX's Falcon 9 rocket experienced a problem during a mission. How long will the vehicle be grounded this time?

item.title: UK government proposes 30% budget cut to astronomy and physics research: 'It's pretty disastrous'
item.description: The UK government is to slash by 30 percent its funding for astronomy, particle and nuclear physics in a move branded as disastrous for the field and likely to affect a generation of researchers.

item.title: Nimoy-Knight Foundation honors 'Girl Spock' and her mission to become the 1st openly autistic woman in space
item.description: The latest recipient of the Foundation's Live Long & Prosper Tribute Award is Jessica Schonhut-Stasik, an astrophysicist and neurodiversity advocate who is affectionately known as "Girl Spock."

item.title: NASA space telescope sees interstellar visitor comet 3I/ATLAS flare up while exiting the solar system
item.description: New infrared observations reveal that the rare interstellar visitor known as comet 3I/ATLAS has dramatically brightened during its farewell tour of the solar system.

item.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved: Release date rumors, platforms, and everything else we know about the Halo remake
item.description: Master Chief is returning in 2026 with a ground-up remake of the original Halo that's promising new content on top of a totally remade presentation.

item.title: James Webb Space Telescope finds precursors to 'building blocks of life' in nearby galaxy
item.description: "We found an unexpected chemical complexity, with abundances far higher than predicted by current theoretical models."

item.title: SpaceX's next astronaut launch for NASA is officially on for Feb. 11 as FAA clears Falcon 9 rocket to fly again
item.description: The FAA has cleared the Falcon 9 rocket to return to flight, freeing NASA and SpaceX to target Feb. 11 for the launch of the Crew-12 astronaut mission to the International Space Station.
